Frequently Asked Questions

How old is Michael Beasley?

Michael Beasley is 37 years old.

Where was Michael Beasley born?

Michael Beasley was born in Cheverly, Maryland.

When was Michael Beasley born?

Michael Beasley was born on January 9, 1989.

How tall is Michael Beasley?

Michael Beasley is 6-9 (206 cm) tall.

How much did Michael Beasley weigh when playing?

Michael Beasley weighed 235 lbs (106 kg) when playing.

Is Michael Beasley in the Hall of Fame?

Michael Beasley is not in the Hall of Fame.

When was Michael Beasley drafted?

Michael Beasley was drafted by Miami Heat, 1st round (2nd pick, 2nd overall), 2008 NBA Draft.

What position did Michael Beasley play?

Power Forward and Small Forward.

When did Michael Beasley retire?

Michael Beasley last played in 2019.

What is Michael Beasley's net worth?

Michael Beasley made at least $40,189,539 playing professional basketball.

How much did Michael Beasley make?

Michael Beasley made $6,262,347 in 2012.

What did Michael Beasley average?

Michael Beasley averaged 12.4 points, 4.7 rebounds, and 1.3 assists per game.

How many rings does Michael Beasley have?

Michael Beasley won 0 championships.

What is Michael Beasley's Instagram account?

Michael Beasley is on Instagram at michael8easley.

What schools did Michael Beasley attend?

Michael Beasley attended Notre Dame Prep in Fitchburg, Massachusetts and Kansas State.

What are Michael Beasley's nicknames?

B-Easy, Walking Bucket, Supercool Beas are nicknames for Michael Beasley.
